Check completion status of project files in a directory

Source: R/check.R
check_completion_status.Rd

Validates that all project files in a directory have successful run records. A successful run is one whose latest run (by submitted_at) has a completion timestamp and, for Monolix, PKanalix and Simulx projects, parsed results.

Usage

check_completion_status(
  directory = ".",
  ext = c("mlxtran", "pkx", "smlx"),
  store = default_store()
)

Arguments

directory

Character scalar. Directory path to check for project files.

ext

Character vector. File extensions to consider as project files. Defaults to c("mlxtran", "pkx", "smlx").

store

Character scalar. The run store directory (see default_store()). Defaults to default_store(). Nothing is written to it.

Value

A data frame with columns:

  • project_file (character): Full path to the project file

  • has_run (logical): Whether any run record exists for this file

  • has_successful_run (logical): Whether the latest run completed with results

  • latest_run_id (character): Most recent run_id (NA if no runs)

  • latest_completed_at (POSIXct): Latest completion timestamp (NA if not completed)

  • recorded_late (logical): Whether the latest run's completion was recorded late (NA if it was not recorded)

  • status (character): Summary status ("completed", "completed_late", "incomplete", "no_results", "no_runs")
